instructions.title: Enter the Terrain Rover
instructions.message: Locate the rover near the SOL 02 starting point and enter through the ladder.
instructions.guidance: Approach the rover ladder and press E to climb inside the rover cabin.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to enter the rover interior.

instructions.title: Review Previous Mission Records
instructions.message: Review saved SOL 01 mission logs, completed tasks, observations and resource records.
instructions.guidance: Access the central command console inside the rover cabin and submit the initial mission record.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and review the previous mission records.

instructions.title: Inspect BOTAN Nutrition System
instructions.message: Verify BOTAN water and nutrient reserves and confirm the system is operational.
instructions.guidance: Approach the BOTAN resource station and record its status.
instructions.activity: Approach Water_and_nut_Trigger and press E to inspect BOTAN.

instructions.title: Inspect Daytime Environment
instructions.message: Record daytime temperature, pressure, wind and atmospheric CO2 readings.
instructions.guidance: Approach the environment sensor display station and record external telemetry.
instructions.activity: Approach Environment_Checking_Trigger and press E to record environmental conditions.

instructions.title: Check Scientific Tools
instructions.message: Inspect the available soil sampling and environmental investigation tools.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the tool rack and confirm the required sampling equipment.
instructions.activity: Approach Tool_Section_Trigger and press E to inspect and confirm scientific tools.

instructions.title: Drive to Sol2_Checkpoint
instructions.message: Follow the navigation beam across the daytime terrain to the checkpoint.
instructions.guidance: Drive the rover toward Sol2_Checkpoint. Use the navigation beam to track the route across the sunlit surface.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to within 50 meters of Sol2_Checkpoint.

instructions.title: Collect Martian Soil Sample
instructions.message: Exit rover on foot, proceed to the investigation site, and extract the sample.
instructions.guidance: Exit the rover, walk to Sol2_Mission_investigation, and press E to collect the soil core.
instructions.activity: Approach Sol2_Mission_investigation on foot and press E to extract soil sample.

instructions.title: Return to the Terrain Rover
instructions.message: Return to the rover with the collected sample and re-enter the vehicle.
instructions.guidance: Climb into the rover through the ladder to continue sample processing.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to store sample in the rover.

instructions.title: Place Soil Sample in the Tools Rack
instructions.message: Place the collected sample in the designated rack and confirm the transfer.
instructions.guidance: Use the tools rack to secure the sample and start its automated analysis.
instructions.activity: Approach Tool_Section_Trigger and press E to transfer the sample.

instructions.title: Analyze Soil Sample in Mission OS
instructions.message: Review the generated soil analysis and save the scientific report.
instructions.guidance: Open Mission OS to review sample results and submit the report.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and review analysis results and save the report.

instructions.title: Drive to Sol2_Finishing_Point
instructions.message: Follow the navigation beam to the mission culmination terminus.
instructions.guidance: Drive the rover across the sunlit plain to Sol2_Finishing_Point.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to within 50 meters of Sol2_Finishing_Point.

instructions.title: Complete SOL 02 Mission
instructions.message: Exit the rover and validate SOL 02 mission completion.
instructions.guidance: Exit the rover, approach the finishing marker, and press E to finalize SOL 02.
instructions.activity: Exit rover and press E at finishing point to complete SOL 02.

completion.title: SOL 02 MISSION COMPLETE
completion.message: All SOL 02 scientific objectives validated. Preparing transfer to SOL 03.
